theorem simultaneous_restriction_domain {F V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F] [Module F V]
  {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] [Fintype κ]
  (u : ι → Submodule F V) (T : κ → V →ₗ[F] V)
  (hpres : ∀ k i x, x ∈ u i → T k x ∈ u i)
  (hcomm : ∀ k l x, T k (T l x) = T l (T k x)) :
  ∃ U : Submodule F V,
    (↑U : Set V) = ⋂ i, (u i).carrier ∧
    ∃ r : κ → U →ₗ[F] U,
      (∀ k x, (r k x : V) = T k (x : V)) ∧
      (∀ k l x, r k (r l x) = r l (r k x)) := by
  let U : Submodule F V := ⨅ i, u i
  have hU : (↑U : Set V) = ⋂ i, (u i).carrier := Submodule.coe_iInf u
  use U, hU
  have hTU : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ U, T k x ∈ U := by
    intro k x hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
    intro i
    exact hpres k i x (hx i)
  let r : κ → U →ₗ[F] U := fun k => ((T k).comp U.subtype).codRestrict U (fun x => hTU k x.1 x.2)
  use r
  refine ⟨fun k x => rfl, ?_⟩
  intro k l x
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hcomm k l x.1
